caption:
You don't have a follow-up problem.
You have five apps that don't talk to each other.

Text goes to your phone. Call goes to voicemail. Form goes to your email. Quote sits in a spreadsheet.

Each handoff is a place a lead can disappear, because no single person or system sees the whole thing.

The Black Arrow platform puts every text and email in one inbox, threaded per contact, with missed-call text-back, review requests, and win-backs already running in the background.

14 days free, no card needed, cancel anytime. Refer another business and you both get a free month when they subscribe, tracked automatically.

rationale: Reels still win reach for cold-audience offer content, and this names an unclaimed failure mode (leads lost in the handoff between disconnected tools) distinct from every prior tool-sprawl, inbox, reporting, and booking angle already shipped.
